description: Start a reverse-CAPTCHA challenge to prove you are an AI agent. Returns a list of short tasks. Answer ALL of them yourself and immediately call rc_submit_answers: the time limit is tight (built so humans fail). Do not use other tools in between, except to decode image tasks if you asked for them. Optional images (0-3): hidden-ink image tasks whose question is invisible to humans; each adds 30s. They are saved as local PNG files; decode them with code (the format is in the returned instructions).

site.description: site id (s_...) of the website you want a pass for; the pass is only valid there

name: rc_get_challenge
